claims.head: The Devils will send Kovacevic and Chisholm at Moore
claims.call: The Devils’ P3 (Kovacevic and Chisholm) spends at least 36% of its 5-on-5 time against the Kings’ third line.
claims.body: At home, the Devils keep sending Kovacevic and Chisholm out against opponents’ third lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Sheldon Keefe has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ third lines. Tonight the Kings’ third line is Armia, Laughton and Moore.

claims.gist: At home, Sheldon Keefe likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Kings’ third line.

claims.head: The Kings’ edge in preventing dangerous shots
claims.body: The Kings are the league’s best for preventing dangerous shots, and the Devils are around the middle. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 3 of their last 5 games, including the last one. Corey Perry takes shifts on two lines, L2 and L4. Joel Edmundson is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Doughty and Ceci.
Kevin Fiala is on injured reserve (lower-leg surgery) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Alex Turcotte is on injured reserve and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Mats Zuccarello is out and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward.
Jared Wright was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Joel Armia and Scott Laughton.
Quinton Byfield is no longer killing penalties: 5% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, down from 43% last season.
Luke Evangelista is out (illness) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-six forward. Dawson Mercer has taken his spot beside Timo Meier and Nico Hischier.
Connor Brown is out and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. Arseny Gritsyuk has taken his spot beside Jesper Bratt and Jack Hughes.
Johnathan Kovacevic was added to the roster on Oct 11 and has played beside Declan Chisholm.

NJD.head: The matchup suits the Devils
NJD.body: Even though New Jersey will be without Evangelista, the Devils have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage, and Los Angeles will be without Fiala. The Kings’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.
